name: POSent
caption: When a purchase order is sent

rules.check: An error in a queued run fails that execution only. Steps before the error keep their work (commit per step); the runs for the other orders go on. When all runs have finished, the progress dialog asks whether to open the failed executions.
rules.message: %1 of %2 executions ended with an error. Do you want to open them?

notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app, which depends on AutoFlow and AutoFlow Core. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.

Queued, like PriceUpdate: Send to supplier creates one execution with a Job Queue entry per purchase order (document type Order only) and published flow, commits, and follows them in a progress dialog ('Sending purchase orders to the supplier'; gives up waiting after 5 minutes, the runs continue in the background).
Also started for one order by the step Start sending purchase order (action 5564017), without a progress dialog.
Each run is an ordinary background run: commit per step, no timeout, Sleep allowed; a failed run keeps what earlier steps wrote, so set Sent Via / Supplier Order Status last.
No configuration: write "configuration": {}. A timeoutSec left over from an earlier version is ignored.
Publish: no trigger-specific checks and no Job Queue entry at publish.
The page action is shown only while at least one flow is published on the trigger.
Outputs marked 'only when …' are not set when the condition fails; a {{trigger_<name>}} token for them then stays in the text verbatim.
